lines.intro: A chaos owl screeches and swoops through the clearing!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the owl?

soothe.great: Fae whispers a quiet tune. The owl settles on a branch.
soothe.good: Fae whispers softly. The owl blinks.
soothe.miss: The owl screeches louder than Fae.

play.great: Maddie plays peekaboo behind a fern. The owl hoots along!
play.good: Maddie wiggles a leaf. The owl leans closer.
play.miss: Maddie pounces at a shadow. The owl flaps away.

cast.great: Sue Sue casts a ribbon into the air. The owl swoops after it!
cast.good: Sue Sue twirls her ribbon. The owl watches.
cast.miss: Sue The ribbon tangles in a branch.

juggle.great: Jordan Jordan juggles pinecones. The owl hoots in rhythm!
juggle.good: Jordan Jordan tosses a pinecone. The owl tilts its head.
juggle.miss: Jordan A pinecone drops with a thunk.

lines.snack: Fae offers a fizzy cracker crumb. The owl nibbles carefully.
lines.burst: The owl screeches and dives through the ferns!

burstResult.great: Fae ducks beneath the swooping wings!
burstResult.good: Fae dodges the owl by a feather.
burstResult.miss: The owl startles Fae with a sharp screech!

lines.soothed: The owl whispers a wise little hoot. The fizzy spell fades away!
lines.rest: Fae needs a quiet rest after that screech.
lines.run: Fae backs away. The owl watches from a branch.
